name: Joses
overview: The name Joses appears in Scripture referring to at least two distinct individuals closely connected to the life and ministry of Jesus Christ. One Joses is identified as one of Jesus' physical brothers, mentioned alongside James, Simon, and Judas, confirming Jesus' genuine human family relationships (Matthew 13:55; Mark 6:3). Another Joses, surnamed Barnabas by the apostles, was a Levite from Cyprus known as 'the son of consolation,' highlighting his role in the early church (Acts 4:36). Additionally, Mary, the mother of James and Joses, is noted among the women who witnessed Jesus' crucifixion and burial (Matthew 27:56; Mark 15:40, 47), underscoring the faithful support surrounding Christ during His passion.
